verdict.comment: A minefield. This should be fast-run and YEOMAN has done well to finish so close the last twice after starting slowly.

comments.absolutelybuzzing: Sole win and best form has been on the AW; no show on stable debut at Chelmsford
comments.addosh: Down the field on stable debut at Huntingdon 18 days ago and others are more intriguing
comments.almudhaffar: Won over 1m on the AW in Ireland; comfortably held in three starts for current yard
comments.alsuileile: Won a similar race under Megan Jordan two goes back and this should be run to suit
comments.amaysmont: In form but nagging concern is that seven of his eight wins have been on the AW
comments.angelofengland: This return to 1m could be a positive and Simon Walker is booked
comments.calanthe: Another good effort on the AW last time; this is only his second Flat run on turf
comments.cathedralpeak: No closer than 5l in four runs for Joseph O'Brien, including one handicap
comments.crownthorpe: Wasn't in good form when last seen 11 months ago and he's a 10yo now
comments.hartswood: Won on last visit here in September and returns having been in good form on the AW
comments.havanaprince: Front-runner who may have needed his last race; jockey is respected in these races
comments.lawsupreme: Dual 1m winner but tailed off in his final two races - on hurdling debut and in a 7f h'cap
comments.liberatedlad: Has struggled in his last three races on the AW and all his wins have been at 1m2f+
comments.loveyourwork: Tends to run his better races on the AW and he's rather in and out on those surfaces
comments.mrjetman: Close third over Newcastle's 1m 17 days ago and that was his first run for this yard
comments.petracelera: Worth another go at 1m but she's not yet hit top gear this year
comments.poetsdawn: This exposed 10yo lacks a recent run and rider is short in experience
comments.risingforce: Nearly won at Southwell this month but that's always been more his scene
comments.serenitydream: Ability is there should the new visor work; being drawn in stall 1 might not be ideal
comments.warningsign: Threatened last year under David Dunsdon and definite chance if resuming in good order
comments.yeoman: Has done well to finish so close the last twice after missing the break
comments.zousjuice: Well held in 7f/1m novices and the same again on handicap debut last summer

races.raceComment: hartswood is marginally preferred with a score of 50.9%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more proven at trip and stronger recent form over addosh. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include excellent form and optimal distance and positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Back down in class and belatedly returned to the scene of his turf win, BILLYJOH is preferred. Second choice is Archduke Ferdinand.

comments.albertcee: Lightly raced 5yo whose record fresh bodes well; debuting for a fourth stable
comments.aleezdancer: Successful in this race in 2023 and finished third last year; one to consider
comments.aramisgrey: Most wins on AW but showed consistent form on turf last year; each-way hopes
comments.archdukeferdinand: Good form towards the end of last season featured a solid C&D effort; in the mix
comments.billyjoh: Form last term included placed efforts in two major handicaps; clear possibilities
comments.bosh: Record of 4-22 for Richard Hannon; hasn't won on turf since 2021
comments.chairmanoftheboard: Prevailed narrowly at Goodwood when last seen; has a modest record in this race
comments.coachello: Effective on turf in the past but hasn't scored in this sphere since early 2023
comments.darkthirty: This may be the time to catch him; defied a higher mark on reappearance last term
comments.eyeofdubai: Similar type to Fine Interview, being a last-time C&D scorer who may improve further
comments.fineinterview: Absent since C&D success five months ago; steadily progressive for current yard
comments.glenfinnan: Appears to need a career-best performance to defy top weight in this field
comments.havanapusey: Lacks recent match practice and consistency; others have stronger claims

verdict.comment: Magico is second choice behind STRESSFREE who has the ability to go very well off this mark and scored over hurdles last month.

comments.asgardscaptain: Seen in regular action on AW since November and usually ran with credit; in calculations
comments.baryshnikov: 9yo with only one win (last May) in nearly three years; 1lb below that last winning mark
comments.chaturanga: Won 1m2f handicaps last May and July; lots to prove on softer than good
comments.cityofdelight: 11116 at 1m2f last term; may resume his progress this season and the market can give clues
comments.cockalorum: Now a 10yo but he won off today's mark in a pretty solid summer campaign last term
comments.cormier: 553 days off before two hurdle races this year, step back in the right direction last time
comments.crimsonroad: Won twice on good/good to firm in 2024; left the Crisfords for 28,000gns in October
comments.fouroneohfever: Began 2024 with three wins; disappointing (July and October) in his last two starts
comments.havesecret: No win since 2022; three 2nds last season and he may well be on the premises
comments.kingscode: 2nd at York last May; went badly the wrong way in his turf starts but some good runs on AW
comments.laafy: Unraced for 1373 days, having joined current yard for 27,000gns almost one year ago
comments.magico: Easily best turf form was C&D; career best on AW 17 days ago; cheekpieces are enlisted
comments.qitaal: Won this race (soft) last year; 8l Chester win in September means he's 9lb higher today
comments.rathgar: Needs to return in top form but he was competitive first time out in last two seasons
comments.royalapproval: Well beaten last June on sole turf start but that was debut; 2-4 on AW this winter
comments.stressfree: Won a maiden hurdle six weeks ago, so should be ready to deliver another big run
comments.theoryoftides: Started his career with two novice wins last May; behind on last three starts; gelded
comments.whiskeypete: Has done best in mud; 105,000gns sale before two heavy defeats on good to firm in Bahrain

races.raceComment: stressfree is marginally preferred with a score of 50.9%, holding clear edges in superior course form over rathgar. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 3 wins from 16 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance and strong course form, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: It's a major puzzle but the most interesting candidate may be YANTARNI, then Circe and Madame De Sevigne.

comments.atarangi: Irish maiden win (7.5f, soft) October, his shortest trip; one to note on h'cap/yard debut
comments.chuzzlewit: 22lb below his peak mark and beaten about 3l in his two AW races this year
comments.circe: Last July's win was 1m on turf and she ended that campaign with a big run over 6f on AW
comments.daringlegend: Two 7f turf wins last summer; a notch or two below his best in three AW runs this winter
comments.goldenpharaoh: Down the weights and close up on penultimate start, but others have more pressing claims
comments.madamedesevigne: Up 2lb for this reappearance but can figure if keeping up the good 7f work

verdict.comment: The likelihood of a fast-run race heightens interest in TROPEZ POWER who could be overlooked in the market.

comments.alzahir: Held his own in handicaps last season and now has first run after wind surgery
comments.anotherinvestment: A 6yo having his 40th career start and has only won twice; 0-11 last season
comments.bubbleswonky: Novice winner; he has been gelded ahead of this campaign and could easily turn a corner
comments.dappervalley: Rated higher in the past so a 3lb rise for his Yarmouth win isn't the end of the world
comments.dolcecourage: Close fourth at Southwell the last time and the blinkers could be a notable addition
comments.grabajabba: Won two 7f novices but beaten about 5l in his two handicaps, both Class 4s
comments.habrdi: Gelded ahead of stable debut and the form is there to figure if he can get back on track
comments.imperialguard: Did well for Andrew Balding; bought for 67,000gns and now gelded; interesting
comments.jenni: Only 1-17 and her Ayr win in September was no springboard to better things
comments.liamartydreams: Won this off a similar mark last year and he's been contesting higher-grade races since
comments.meresidemadness: All three wins have been on the AW; he hasn't reached quite the same heights on turf (0-7)
comments.onemorenomore: Three-time winner here and returned to his best with a near miss at Southwell
comments.stockpyle: Four wins; the race he ran at Newcastle recently smacked of a horse who needed the run
comments.tropezpower: Struggled of late but a free-goer for whom a good pace up front would aid the cause no end
comments.zip: Goes well here and has been in fine form on the AW; another bold show looks on the cards

races.raceComment: onemorenomore is marginally preferred with a score of 51.6%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and superior course form over liamartydreams. Won 1 of last 6 starts.
